pairs.evidence: Distinctive V-braced timber posts, low metal roof, garage and entry-door arrangement, and red metal barn behind. Different camera positions.

pairs.evidence: Asymmetric gable profile, red metal siding, white trim around the large offset door, side extension, and boulders at the wooded right edge. Different framing.

pairs.title: Through the barn
pairs.evidence: View from the tall barn through the same rectangular opening into a lower-ceiling passage, repeating crossbeams, metal walls and vertical studs, and daylight at the far end. Same viewing direction; different framing.

source_note: Before and during photographs supplied by the owner. Finished photographs from the property's Zillow listing. Before/during dates come from source image metadata. No completion date has been supplied.
